description: Bulk load of two imports, each in its own subdirectory with its own config.json and provenance (import_names = [ALL_IMPORTS]). Output folders are named after the provenance (importName is not used for folders), and the handshake must list both. Each Source lands in the folder of the MCF file that defines it; global nodes (the dc/g/Root StatVarGroup) land in the alphabetically first import folder.
